description.value: Unintelligent curses will not attack unless provoked and when a curse dies within 1 mile of you, your third eye weeps, alerting you to its death. In addition, you have advantage on Religion or Arcana checks related to cursed spirits and kalyans.

jjk5e.automationNotes: Advantage on Religion/Arcana checks about cursed spirits: choose it in the roll dialog.
